verdict.rationale: Greptile docs describe an iterative loop where pushing fixes leads to re-review until a 'perfect' 5/5 score with zero unresolved comments (greptile-docs-13), implying it tracks which issues are resolved across commits rather than re-flagging them, and it also learns from reviewer feedback over time (greptile-docs-4). However, there is no explicit documentation describing the incremental-diff re-review mechanism or confirmation that previously-raised comments are marked resolved instead of repeated on new commits. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of incremental commit-triggered re-review logic, evidence/independent confirmation that old comments aren't repeated after fixes.
